nodes.label: Group C Business Governance and Scale
Money
nodes.rationale: ADR-0130: Money is an exact decimal plus a CurrencyCode and deliberately not a Quantity<TDimension>; currency is not a physical dimension and any conversion factor in the type system is wrong on most days.

nodes.label: P07 Business Governance and Scale
nodes.rationale: What the organisation is committed to, exposed to, permitted to use, charging, forecasting, pursuing and limited by.

nodes.label: ADR-0129
nodes.rationale: Every P07 library is a ReferenceDataCatalog over the Engineering Data Model with its own Kind and secondary index, the same shared lifecycle Group A and B use, and no third one.

nodes.label: Template Integration Outstanding
nodes.rationale: The mandatory source templates in an external Claude Design project returned HTTP 403 and no equivalent existed in the repository; rather than invent them, P07 was designed from the repository and the framework is built to receive them.

nodes.label: Not an Accounting Package
nodes.rationale: C5 compares figures somebody else recorded; it posts, recognises, depreciates and computes nothing anybody should file.

nodes.label: DeterminationState
nodes.rationale: NotDetermined, Recorded, Assumed, ReviewRequired, NotApplicable, Disputed; ReviewRequired keeps the platform out of legal and accounting practice by recording whose determination it is and that it has not been made.

nodes.label: AuthorityRequirement
nodes.rationale: No P07 type or service constructs a BusinessAuthorisation; an absence reports as an actionable requirement naming somebody, not as a silence.

nodes.label: BusinessGovernanceFacts
nodes.rationale: Composed into each domain definition, never inherited: eleven unrelated domains share governance and nothing else.

nodes.label: Two States Not One
nodes.rationale: Governance state answers may work rely on this record; domain status answers what is the commercial position; a Released contract record can still be in negotiation.

nodes.label: P07 Validation Series
nodes.rationale: 141 rules across BGV, BGC, BGR, BGI, BGP, BGF, BGD, BGO, BGQ; the shared ten run once by BusinessGovernanceValidator rather than eleven times.

nodes.label: IssuedContract Pins Template Revision
nodes.rationale: The shared lifecycle refuses to edit a released template so revising one cannot alter a contract already issued.

nodes.label: IContractService
nodes.rationale: Prepares a draft, resolves a pinned template, reports obligations; executes nothing.

nodes.label: Risk and Insurance Separate
nodes.rationale: Transfer moves who pays, not whether the event happens; an insured risk stays open with the policy recorded against it.

nodes.label: RiskAcceptance
nodes.rationale: IsAccepted is true only where a named person exercised acceptance, never because the band is low.

nodes.label: RiskExposures
nodes.rationale: A deterministic matrix returning a band never a score; a severe impact is never merely Low however rare and NotAssessed propagates rather than defaulting to safe.

nodes.label: CoverageAssessment
nodes.rationale: Stops one step short of covered by construction; whether a policy would respond is the insurer determination.

nodes.label: IPOwnership
nodes.rationale: Origin is a fact about history, ownership a legal conclusion; defaults to NotDetermined because holding an asset establishes nothing about owning it.

nodes.label: ComplianceReviewState
nodes.rationale: Validation says nobody qualified has said so, never not compliant.

nodes.label: RateKind
nodes.rationale: List, quoted, negotiated and realised kept as four facts; a business keeping one cannot say where the margin goes.

nodes.label: PricingService
nodes.rationale: Refuses to quote from a card not both released and approved; FindApplicableAsync returns every candidate because two cards claiming one day is a governance failure the caller must see; ReproduceAsync skips the check so an old quotation reproduces its price.

nodes.label: FinancialFigureKind
nodes.rationale: Actual, budget, forecast, committed, baseline; Actual is the one kind P07 cannot originate and IsUnsupportedActual catches a relabelled forecast.

nodes.label: FinancialVariance
nodes.rationale: Computed never stored, direction-aware, null against a zero expectation rather than infinity.

nodes.label: RevenueReality
nodes.rationale: Potential, contracted, invoiced, realised kept separate; PipelinePosition carries no single pipeline value because adding or probability-weighting them describes no possible future.

nodes.label: DecisionGate
nodes.rationale: Has no field for a decision: a question, measure, threshold, recorded value, review date and decider; a crossed threshold is not itself a decision and a measurement older than 90 days is stale.

nodes.label: CommittedProductiveDays
nodes.rationale: Counts only secured resources: a plan sized on people nobody has hired is a plan, not a capacity.

nodes.label: ReferencePin Promoted to ReferenceData
nodes.rationale: Moved from EngineeringIntelligence to Tempest.Core.ReferenceData because pinning a record at a revision is reference-data vocabulary P07 needs as much as P02.

nodes.label: Business Data Ships Empty
nodes.rationale: Populating libraries with plausible-looking business, legal or financial facts would be the most damaging thing the programme could do; the commissioning instruction forbids it.

nodes.label: P07 Depends on Nothing Above
nodes.rationale: Reads only the document store, persistence and identity; registered last in TempestHost.
